preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call sumBounsPiece()

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call sumBounsPiece(yesToday, veryLargeNumber) to set dayPoolBounsPiece to an excessively high value. This will cause _sumCanGetToken() to revert when users attempt to claim bonuses via receiveBounsToken(), as the subtraction dayPoolBouns[yesToday].sub(_yesTodayToken) will fail due to the inflated dayPoolBounsPiece value making _yesTodayToken larger than dayPoolBouns[yesToday]. This effectively breaks the bonus distribution mechanism for all users.
